**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of the problem or diagnostic blind spot.

**Describe the Solution You'd Like**
A clear and concise description of what collector or analyzer rule you would like to see added.

**Target Data Source (Read-Only)**
- [ ] Registry Key
- [ ] WMI / CIM Class
- [ ] PowerShell Cmdlet
- [ ] Windows Event Log
- [ ] Filesystem Metadata

**Confirm Safety Invariant**
- [ ] This feature requires **read-only** access and does **not** alter the host OS or registry.
